deduplication.alphabet: events deduplicated by equality, first occurrence kept
deduplication.deliveries: not deduplicated: one per (instance, prefix, suffix)
deduplication.prefixes: the two orders' prefixes, deduplicated as event tuples

domain.prefixes: 164: every prefix of each instance's causal order and of its reversed order
domain.replica: one correct replica (no mutant flags), the instance's policy
domain.suffixes: 297 in all, plus the empty suffix: each event of the instance's serialization alphabet (its own events, the unrelated lineage M's events, the boundary events) and each declared boundary sequence

alphabet_corpus.not_claimed: not every reachable replica state: only these delivery orders (two per instance), at most one suffix after a prefix, the declared alphabet, one replica, the correct implementation
